k-sym-牛逼.title: 牛逼 (niubi) coins after Musk post
k-sym-牛逼.sourceSays: Posts say Elon Musk wrote "Chinese 𝕏 is 牛逼" on Nov 9; on Nov 20 Armani Ferrante posted "The technical term for this is 牛逼" (a coin's description), and another account called it the first Chinese concept coin.
k-sym-牛逼.reason: Musk post (Nov 9, 25M views) precedes the pools opened about 0.5-1.1h ago; one coin copies the Ferrante post text; a Chinese post says it is a Chinese concept. Link of coins to the posts is unverified.
